changes.glyph_alignment: Keys use visible glyph ink bounds from TextServer, excluding the cyan base. Word rows use full unchanged ink bounds; active key background is drawn before all letters so its bevel cannot hide the next letter. Font cache is bounded at512 entries.
changes.world_framing: All combat stages and HUD scenery share full-viewport aspect-preserving cover and the same animated shader. Playfield clips scenery to its bounds so the full image cannot cover HUD buttons. Castle build view keeps its own framing until combat.
changes.racing: Two original robot drivers use three HD native Grok clips. Cars, finish marks and native exhaust use one track mapping. Space gives four seconds of35% extra word advance; no rival teleport. Legacy interference ring and caption removed. Three bounded exhaust emitters and one scenery-only nitro light respect pause/reduced motion.
changes.delivery: Racing imagery is only in the on-demand racing pack; no source video in the export. Superseded rally HD atlas files excluded.
changes.hud: All thirteen games share physical enamel title/stat/command plates and a cream definition panel. Meaning, finger and Space ability have protected material groups. Mode-specific wave, opponent, shield and feedback stamps use the same skin; redundant floating instructions removed. Native glyph-ink centering is shared with HUD captions.

limits: Native local GPU measurements are not browser/mobile or all-hardware guarantees.
Broader product-polish objective remains active; this release does not claim every game is finished.
